limit.\nfunc (s *State) AddLogEntry(msg string) {\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\tentry := LogEntry{\n\t\tTime: time.Now().Format(\"15:04:05\"),\n\t\tMsg:  msg,\n\t}\n\ts.messageLog = append(s.messageLog, entry)\n\tif len(s.messageLog) > maxLogEntries {\n\t\ts.messageLog = s.messageLog[1:]\n\t}\n\ts.lastUpdate = time.Now()\n}\n\n// AddCommandEntry adds a command entry, respecting the max limit.\nfunc (s *State) AddCommandEntry(cmd string, userID int64, success bool) {\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\tentry := CommandEntry{\n\t\tTime:    time.Now().Format(\"15:04:05\"),\n\t\tCommand: cmd,\n\t\tUserID:  userID,\n\t\tSuccess: success,\n\t}\n\ts.commandLog = append(s.commandLog, entry)\n\tif len(s.commandLog) > maxCmdEntries {\n\t\ts.commandLog = s.commandLog[1:]\n\t}\n\ts.lastUpdate = time.Now()\n}\n\n// UpdateSession updates a session in the state.\nfunc (s *State) UpdateSession(chatID, threadID int64, sessionID, model, status, notifMode, cwd string, msgCount int, cost float64) {\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\tkey := fmt.Sprintf(\"%d:%d\", chatID, threadID)\n\tsession := s.sessions[key]\n\tif session == nil {\n\t\tsession = &SessionInfo{\n\t\t\tChatID:     chatID,\n\t\t\tThreadID:   threadID,\n\t\t\tSessionID:  sessionID,\n\t\t\tLastActive: time.Now(),\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.sessions[key] = session\n\t}\n\tsession.Model = model\n\tsession.Status = status\n\tsession.NotificationMode = notifMode\n\tsession.CWD = cwd\n\tsession.MessageCount = msgCount\n\tsession.TotalCostUSD = cost\n\tsession.LastActive = time.Now()\n\ts.lastUpdate = time.Now()\n}\n\n// RemoveSession removes a session from the state.\nfunc (s *State) RemoveSession(chatID, threadID int64) {\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\tkey := fmt.Sprintf(\"%d:%d\", chatID, threadID)\n\tdelete(s.sessions, key)\n\ts.lastUpdate = time.Now()\n}\n\n// UpdateHealth updates the health status.\nfunc (s *State) UpdateHealth(healthy bool, checks []HealthCheck) {\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\ts.health.Healthy = healthy\n\ts.health.Checks = checks\n\ts.health.Timestamp = time.Now()\n\ts.lastUpdate = time.Now()\n}\n\n// GetSessions returns a copy of the current sessions.\nfunc (s *State) GetSessions() []*SessionInfo {\n\ts.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer s.mu.RUnlock()\n\tsessions := make([]*SessionInfo, 0, len(s.sessions))\n\tfor _, sess := range s.sessions {\n\t\tsessions = append(sessions, sess)\n\t}\n\treturn sessions\n}\n\n// GetHealth returns a copy of the health status.\nfunc (s *State) GetHealth() HealthStatus {\n\ts.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer s.mu.RUnlock()\n\treturn s.health\n}\n\n// GetMessageLog returns a copy of the message log.\nfunc (s *State) GetMessageLog() []LogEntry {\n\ts.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer s.mu.RUnlock()\n\tlog := make([]LogEntry, len(s.messageLog))\n\tcopy(log, s.messageLog)\n\treturn log\n}\n\n// GetCommandLog returns a copy of the command log.\nfunc (s *State) GetCommandLog() []CommandEntry {\n\ts.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer s.mu.RUnlock()\n\tlog := make([]CommandEntry, len(s.commandLog))\n\tcopy(log, s.commandLog)\n\treturn log\n}\n\n// GetTotalCost returns the total cost across all sessions.\nfunc (s *State) GetTotalCost() float64 {\n\ts.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer s.mu.RUnlock()\n\ttotal := 0.0\n\tfor _, sess := range s.sessions {\n\t\ttotal += sess.TotalCostUSD\n\t}\n\treturn total\n}\n\n// GetActiveMessageCount returns the count of active messages.\nfunc (s *State) GetActiveMessageCount() int {\n\ts.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer s.mu.RUnlock()\n\treturn s.activeMessageCount\n}\n\n// IncrementActiveMessageCount increments the active message count.\nfunc (s *State) IncrementActiveMessageCount() {\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\ts.activeMessageCount++\n\ts.lastUpdate = time.Now()\n}\n\n// DecrementActiveMessageCount decrements the active message count.\nfunc (s *State) DecrementActiveMessageCount() {\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\tif s.activeMessageCount > 0 {\n\t\ts.activeMessageCount--\n\t}\n\ts.lastUpdate = time.Now()\n}\n\n// AddCostEntry adds a cost entry with timestamp.\nfunc (s *State) AddCostEntry(chatID, threadID int64, costUSD float64, model string) {\n\ts.mu.Lock()\n\tdefer s.mu.Unlock()\n\tentry := CostEntry{\n\t\tTime:     time.Now(),\n\t\tChatID:   chatID,\n\t\tThreadID: threadID,\n\t\tCostUSD:  costUSD,\n\t\tModel:    model,\n\t}\n\ts.costLog = append(s.costLog, entry)\n\tif len(s.costLog) > maxCostEntries {\n\t\ts.costLog = s.costLog[1:]\n\t}\n\ts.lastUpdate = time.Now()\n}\n\n// GetCostToday returns the total cost for today (UTC).\nfunc (s *State) GetCostToday() float64 {\n\ts.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer s.mu.RUnlock()\n\tnow := time.Now().UTC()\n\ttodayStart := time.Date(now.Year(), now.Month(), now.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)\n\ttotal := 0.0\n\tfor _, entry := range s.costLog {\n\t\tif entry.Time.UTC().After(todayStart) || entry.Time.UTC().Equal(todayStart) {\n\t\t\ttotal += entry.CostUSD\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn total\n}\n\n// GetCostThisHour returns the total cost for the current hour (UTC).\nfunc (s *State) GetCostThisHour() float64 {\n\ts.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer s.mu.RUnlock()\n\tnow := time.Now().UTC()\n\thourStart := time.Date(now.Year(), now.Month(), now.Day(), now.Hour(), 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)\n\ttotal := 0.0\n\tfor _, entry := range s.costLog {\n\t\tif entry.Time.UTC().After(hourStart) || entry.Time.UTC().Equal(hourStart) {\n\t\t\ttotal += entry.CostUSD\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn total\n}\n\n// tickMsg is sent periodically to update the UI.\ntype tickMsg time.Time\n\n// eventReceivedMsg is sent when an event is received from the socket.\ntype eventReceivedMsg Event\n\n// connectedMsg is sent when successfully connected to the event socket.\ntype connectedMsg struct {\n\tConn net.Conn\n}\n\n// disconnectedMsg is sent when disconnected from the event socket.\ntype disconnectedMsg struct {\n\terr error\n}\n\n// eventWithConnMsg carries an event along with its connection.\ntype eventWithConnMsg struct {\n\tEvent Event\n\tConn  net.Conn\n}\n\n// model is the Bubble Tea model for the dashboard.\ntype model struct {\n\tstate          *State\n\tconn           net.Conn\n\tsocketPath     string\n\treconnectDelay time.Duration\n\twidth          int\n\theight         int\n\tconnected      bool\n\tlastError      error\n\tquitting       bool\n}\n\n// initialModel creates the initial model.\nfunc initialModel(socketPath string) model {\n\treturn model{\n\t\tstate:          NewState(),\n\t\tsocketPath:     socketPath,\n\t\treconnectDelay: time.Second,\n\t\twidth:          80,\n\t\theight:         24,\n\t\tconnected:      false,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Init initializes the model.\nfunc (m model) Init() tea.Cmd {\n\treturn tea.Batch(\n\t\tm.connectCmd(),\n\t\ttickCmd(),\n\t)\n}\n\n// Update handles messages and updates the model.\nfunc (m model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {\n\tswitch msg := msg.(type) {\n\tcase tea.KeyMsg:\n\t\tswitch msg.String() {\n\t\tcase \"q\", \"ctrl+c\":\n\t\t\tm.quitting = true\n\t\t\treturn m, tea.Quit\n\t\tcase \"r\":\n\t\t\t// Force reconnect\n\t\t\tif m.conn != nil {\n\t\t\t\tm.conn.Close()\n\t\t\t\tm.conn = nil\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tm.connected = false\n\t\t\treturn m, m.connectCmd()\n\t\t}\n\tcase connectedMsg:\n\t\tm.connected = true\n\t\tm.lastError = nil\n\t\tm.reconnectDelay = time.Second\n\t\tif m.conn != nil {\n\t\t\tm.conn.Close()\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.conn = msg.Conn\n\t\treturn m, waitForNextEvent(msg.Conn)\n\tcase disconnectedMsg:\n\t\tm.connected = false\n\t\tm.lastError = msg.err\n\t\tif m.conn != nil {\n\t\t\tm.conn.Close()\n\t\t\tm.conn = nil\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn m, tea.Tick(m.reconnectDelay, func(t time.Time) tea.Msg {\n\t\t\treturn connectedMsg{}\n\t\t})\n\tcase eventWithConnMsg:\n\t\t// Store the connection and handle the event\n\t\tif m.conn != nil {\n\t\t\tm.conn.Close()\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.conn = msg.Conn\n\t\tm.connected = true\n\t\tm.lastError = nil\n\t\tm.handleEvent(msg.Event)\n\t\treturn m, waitForNextEvent(msg.Conn)\n\tcase eventReceivedMsg:\n\t\tm.handleEvent(Event(msg))\n\t\treturn m, m.readEventsCmd()\n\tcase tickMsg:\n\t\treturn m, tickCmd()\n\tcase tea.WindowSizeMsg:\n\t\tm.width = msg.Width\n\t\tm.height = msg.Height\n\t\treturn m, nil\n\t}\n\treturn m, nil\n}\n\n// handleEvent processes a single event from the stream.\nfunc (m *model) handleEvent(event Event) {\n\tswitch event.Type {\n\tcase \"session_created\", \"session_updated\":\n\t\tchatID := int64(event.Data[\"chat_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tthreadID := int64(event.Data[\"thread_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tsessionID := event.Data[\"session_id\"].(string)\n\t\tmodel := \"\"\n\t\tif m, ok := event.Data[\"model\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tmodel = m\n\t\t}\n\t\tstatus := \"\"\n\t\tif s, ok := event.Data[\"status\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tstatus = s\n\t\t}\n\t\tnotifMode := \"live\"\n\t\tif nm, ok := event.Data[\"notification_mode\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tnotifMode = nm\n\t\t}\n\t\tcwd := \"\"\n\t\tif c, ok := event.Data[\"cwd\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tcwd = c\n\t\t}\n\t\tmsgCount := 0\n\t\tif mc, ok := event.Data[\"message_count\"].(float64); ok {\n\t\t\tmsgCount = int(mc)\n\t\t}\n\t\tcost := 0.0\n\t\tif c, ok := event.Data[\"total_cost_usd\"].(float64); ok {\n\t\t\tcost = c\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.state.UpdateSession(chatID, threadID, sessionID, model, status, notifMode, cwd, msgCount, cost)\n\tcase \"session_closed\":\n\t\tchatID := int64(event.Data[\"chat_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tthreadID := int64(event.Data[\"thread_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tm.state.RemoveSession(chatID, threadID)\n\tcase \"message_received\":\n\t\tchatID := int64(event.Data[\"chat_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tthreadID := int64(event.Data[\"thread_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tmessageID := int64(event.Data[\"message_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tcontentType := \"\"\n\t\tif ct, ok := event.Data[\"content_type\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tcontentType = ct\n\t\t}\n\t\tuserID := int64(event.Data[\"user_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tm.state.AddLogEntry(fmt.Sprintf(\"MSG IN ch=%d th=%d msg=%d type=%s uid=%d\", chatID, threadID, messageID, contentType, userID))\n\t\tm.state.IncrementActiveMessageCount()\n\tcase \"message_sent\":\n\t\tchatID := int64(event.Data[\"chat_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tthreadID := int64(event.Data[\"thread_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tmessageID := int64(event.Data[\"message_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tpurpose := \"\"\n\t\tif p, ok := event.Data[\"purpose\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tpurpose = p\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.state.AddLogEntry(fmt.Sprintf(\"MSG OUT ch=%d th=%d msg=%d purp=%s\", chatID, threadID, messageID, purpose))\n\t\tm.state.DecrementActiveMessageCount()\n\tcase \"command_executed\":\n\t\tchatID := int64(event.Data[\"chat_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tcommand := \"\"\n\t\tif c, ok := event.Data[\"command\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tcommand = c\n\t\t}\n\t\tuserID := int64(event.Data[\"user_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tsuccess := false\n\t\tif s, ok := event.Data[\"success\"].(bool); ok {\n\t\t\tsuccess = s\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.state.AddCommandEntry(command, userID, success)\n\t\tm.state.AddLogEntry(fmt.Sprintf(\"CMD ch=%d %s uid=%d ok=%t\", chatID, command, userID, success))\n\tcase \"cost_recorded\":\n\t\tchatID := int64(event.Data[\"chat_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tthreadID := int64(event.Data[\"thread_id\"].(float64))\n\t\tcostUSD := 0.0\n\t\tif c, ok := event.Data[\"cost_usd\"].(float64); ok {\n\t\t\tcostUSD = c\n\t\t}\n\t\tmodel := \"\"\n\t\tif m, ok := event.Data[\"model\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tmodel = m\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.state.AddCostEntry(chatID, threadID, costUSD, model)\n\t\tm.state.AddLogEntry(fmt.Sprintf(\"COST ch=%d th=%d $%.4f %s\", chatID, threadID, costUSD, model))\n\tcase \"health_check\":\n\t\thealthy := false\n\t\tif h, ok := event.Data[\"healthy\"].(bool); ok {\n\t\t\thealthy = h\n\t\t}\n\t\tchecks := []HealthCheck{}\n\t\tif c, ok := event.Data[\"checks\"].([]interface{}); ok {\n\t\t\tfor _, checkItem := range c {\n\t\t\t\tif checkMap, ok := checkItem.(map[string]interface{}); ok {\n\t\t\t\t\tcheck := HealthCheck{}\n\t\t\t\t\tif name, ok := checkMap[\"name\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcheck.Name = name\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\tif healthy, ok := checkMap[\"healthy\"].(bool); ok {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcheck.Healthy = healthy\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\tif msg, ok := checkMap[\"message\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcheck.Message = msg\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\tchecks = append(checks, check)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.state.UpdateHealth(healthy, checks)\n\tcase \"system_error\":\n\t\tcomponent := \"\"\n\t\tif c, ok := event.Data[\"component\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tcomponent = c\n\t\t}\n\t\tmessage := \"\"\n\t\tif m, ok := event.Data[\"message\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tmessage = m\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.state.AddLogEntry(fmt.Sprintf(\"ERROR [%s] %s\", component, message))\n\tcase \"system_info\":\n\t\tmessage := \"\"\n\t\tif m, ok := event.Data[\"message\"].(string); ok {\n\t\t\tmessage = m\n\t\t}\n\t\tm.state.AddLogEntry(fmt.Sprintf(\"INFO %s\", message))\n\t}\n}\n\n// View renders the UI.\nfunc (m model) View() string {\n\tif m.quitting {\n\t\treturn \"Goodbye!\\n\"\n\t}\n\n\t// Define styles\n\ttitleStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().\n\t\tBold(true).\n\t\tForeground(lipgloss.Color(\"86\")). // Light blue\n\t\tMarginBottom(1)\n\n\tpanelStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().\n\t\tBorder(lipgloss.RoundedBorder()).\n\t\tBorderForeground(lipgloss.Color(\"238\")). // Grey\n\t\tPadding(0, 1)\n\n\theaderStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().\n\t\tBold(true).\n\t\tForeground(lipgloss.Color(\"228\")). // Yellow\n\t\tMarginBottom(1)\n\n\tsuccessStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color(\"142\")) // Green\n\terrorStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color(\"203\"))   // Red\n\twarningStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color(\"229\")) // Yellow\n\tdimStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().Foreground(lipgloss.Color(\"241\"))    // Grey\n\tstatusStyle := lipgloss.NewStyle().Bold(true)                       // Bold for status\n\n\t// Calculate layout\n\tleftWidth := m.width / 2\n\trightWidth := m.width - leftWidth - 4 // 4 for borders/gaps\n\n\tsessionHeight := m.height / 2\n\thealthHeight := 6\n\tlogHeight := m.height - sessionHeight - healthHeight - 4 // 4 for headers/gaps\n\n\t// Header\n\theader := titleStyle.Render(\"Telegram Claude Bridge Dashboard\")\n\tif m.connected {\n\t\theader += successStyle.Render(\" ● Connected\")\n\t} else {\n\t\theader += errorStyle.Render(\" ● Disconnected\")\n\t\tif m.lastError != nil {\n\t\t\theader += dimStyle.Render(fmt.Sprintf(\" (%s)\", m.lastError))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\theader += dimStyle.Render(\" | Press 'q' to quit, 'r' to reconnect\")\n\n\t// Active Sessions Panel\n\tsessions := m.state.GetSessions()\n\tsessionsPanel := headerStyle.Render(\"Active Sessions\") + \"\\n\"\n\tif len(sessions) == 0 {\n\t\tsessionsPanel += dimStyle.Render(\"No active sessions\")\n\t} else {\n\t\tfor i, sess := range sessions {\n\t\t\tif i >= sessionHeight-2 {\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tstatusColor := successStyle\n\t\t\tif sess.Status == \"blocked\" {\n\t\t\t\tstatusColor = warningStyle\n\t\t\t} else if sess.Status == \"error\" {\n\t\t\t\tstatusColor = errorStyle\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tline := fmt.Sprintf(\"%s ch=%d th=%d %s msgs=%d cost=$%.4f\",\n\t\t\t\tstatusStyle.Render(sess.Status),\n\t\t\t\tsess.ChatID, sess.ThreadID,\n\t\t\t\ttruncateString(sess.Model, 12),\n\t\t\t\tsess.MessageCount, sess.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tif sess.NotificationMode != \"live\" {\n\t\t\t\tline += dimStyle.Render(fmt.Sprintf(\" [%s]\", sess.NotificationMode))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tsessionsPanel += statusColor.Render(line) + \"\\n\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(sessions) > sessionHeight-2 {\n\t\t\tsessionsPanel += dimStyle.Render(fmt.Sprintf(\"... and %d more\", len(sessions)-(sessionHeight-2)))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// System Health Panel\n\thealth := m.state.GetHealth()\n\thealthPanel := headerStyle.Render(\"System Health\") + \"\\n\"\n\tfor _, check := range health.Checks {\n\t\tcheckStyle := successStyle\n\t\tif !check.Healthy {\n\t\t\tcheckStyle = errorStyle\n\t\t}\n\t\tmsg := check.Message\n\t\tif msg == \"\" {\n\t\t\tmsg = \"ok\"\n\t\t}\n\t\thealthPanel += fmt.Sprintf(\"%s %-12s %s\\n\",\n\t\t\tcheckStyle.Render(statusIcon(check.Healthy)),\n\t\t\tcheck.Name+\":\", checkStyle.Render(msg),\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\t// Messages In Flight Panel\n\tlogEntries := m.state.GetMessageLog()\n\tlogPanel := headerStyle.Render(fmt.Sprintf(\"Messages In Flight (%d active)\", m.state.GetActiveMessageCount())) + \"\\n\"\n\tstartIdx := len(logEntries) - logHeight + 1\n\tif startIdx < 0 {\n\t\tstartIdx = 0\n\t}\n\tfor i := startIdx; i < len(logEntries); i++ {\n\t\tlogPanel += dimStyle.Render(logEntries[i].Time+\" \") + logEntries[i].Msg + \"\\n\"\n\t}\n\n\t// Command Log Panel\n\tcmdEntries := m.state.GetCommandLog()\n\tcmdPanel := headerStyle.Render(\"Command Log\") + \"\\n\"\n\tcmdStartIdx := len(cmdEntries) - logHeight + 1\n\tif cmdStartIdx < 0 {\n\t\tcmdStartIdx = 0\n\t}\n\tfor i := cmdStartIdx; i < len(cmdEntries); i++ {\n\t\tcmd := cmdEntries[i]\n\t\tcmdStyle := successStyle\n\t\tif !cmd.Success {\n\t\t\tcmdStyle = errorStyle\n\t\t}\n\t\tcmdPanel += dimStyle.Render(cmd.Time+\" \") +\n\t\t\tcmdStyle.Render(truncateString(cmd.Command, 30)) +\n\t\t\tdimStyle.Render(fmt.Sprintf(\" uid=%d\", cmd.UserID)) + \"\\n\"\n\t}\n\n\t// Cost Tracker Panel\n\ttotalCost := m.state.GetTotalCost()\n\tcostToday := m.state.GetCostToday()\n\tcostThisHour := m.state.GetCostThisHour()\n\tactiveCount := len(sessions)\n\n\tcostPanel := headerStyle.Render(\"Cost Tracker\") + \"\\n\"\n\tcostPanel += fmt.Sprintf(\"Today: $%.4f  │  This Hour: $%.4f  │  Active: %d\\n\", costToday, costThisHour, activeCount)\n\tcostPanel += dimStyle.Render(fmt.Sprintf(\"Total: $%.4f\\n\", totalCost))\n\tif len(sessions) > 0 {\n\t\tcostPanel += dimStyle.Render(\"Top sessions by cost:\\n\")\n\t\t// Sort sessions by cost\n\t\tsortedSessions := make([]*SessionInfo, len(sessions))\n\t\tcopy(sortedSessions, sessions)\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < len(sortedSessions)-1; i++ {\n\t\t\tfor j := i + 1; j < len(sortedSessions); j++ {\n\t\t\t\tif sortedSessions[j].TotalCostUSD > sortedSessions[i].TotalCostUSD {\n\t\t\t\t\tsortedSessions[i], sortedSessions[j] = sortedSessions[j], sortedSessions[i]\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i := 0; i < len(sortedSessions) && i < 3; i++ {\n\t\t\tsess := sortedSessions[i]\n\t\t\tcostPanel += fmt.Sprintf(\"  ch=%d th=%d: $%.4f\\n\", sess.ChatID, sess.ThreadID, sess.TotalCostUSD)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Layout\n\tleftColumn := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left,\n\t\tpanelStyle.Width(leftWidth).Height(sessionHeight).Render(sessionsPanel),\n\t\tpanelStyle.Width(leftWidth).Height(healthHeight).Render(healthPanel),\n\t)\n\trightColumn := lipgloss.JoinVertical(lipgloss.Left,\n\t\tpanelStyle.Width(rightWidth).Height(logHeight).Render(logPanel),\n\t\tpanelStyle.Width(rightWidth).Height(logHeight).Render(cmdPanel),\n\t\tpanelStyle.Width(rightWidth).Height(6).Render(costPanel),\n\t)\n\n\tmainContent := lipgloss.JoinHorizontal(lipgloss.Top, leftColumn, rightColumn)\n\n\treturn header + \"\\n\" + mainContent\n}\n\n// statusIcon returns a checkmark or cross icon.\nfunc statusIcon(healthy bool) path, enables WAL mode,\n303\t// and applies any pending migrations.\n304\tfunc OpenDB(path string) (*DB, error) {\n305\t\tdb, err := sql.Open(\"sqlite\", path)\n306\t\tif err != nil {\n307\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"open sqlite %q: %w\", path, err)\n308\t\t}\n309\t\n310\t\t// SQLite works best with a single writer connection.\n311\t\tdb.SetMaxOpenConns(1)\n312\t\n313\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;\"); err != nil {\n314\t\t\tdb.Close()\n315\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable WAL: %w\", err)\n316\t\t}\n317\t\tif _, err := db.Exec(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;\"); err != nil {\n318\t\t\tdb.Close()\n319\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"enable foreign keys: %w\", err)\n320\t\t}\n321\t\n322\t\td := &DB{db: db}\n323\t\tif err := d.migrate(); err != nil {\n324\t\t\tdb.Close()\n325\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"migrate: %w\", err)\n326\t\t}\n327\t\treturn d, nil\n328\t}\n329\t\n330\t// Close closes the underlying database connection.\n331\tfunc (d *DB) Close() error {\n332\t\treturn d.db.Close()\n333\t}\n334\t\n335\t// SqlDB returns the underlying *sql.DB for use with other packages.\n336\tfunc (d *DB) SqlDB() *sql.DB {\n337\t\treturn d.db\n338\t}\n339\t\n340\t// migrate creates the schema_version table if needed, then applies any\n341\t// migrations whose version number exceeds the current schema version.\n342\tfunc (d *DB) migrate() error {\n343\t\t_, err := d.db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_version (\n344\t\t\tversion    INTEGER NOT NULL,\n345\t\t\tapplied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n346\t\t);`)\n347\t\tif err != nil {\n348\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"create schema_version: %w\", err)\n349\t\t}\n350\t\n351\t\tvar current int\n352\t\trow := d.db.QueryRow(`SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_version`)\n353\t\tif err := row.Scan(&current); err != nil {\n354\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"read schema_version: %w\", err)\n355\t\t}\n356\t\n357\t\tfor i, ddl := range migrations {\n358\t\t\tversion := i + 1\n359\t\t\tif version <= current {\n360\t\t\t\tcontinue\n361\t\t\t}\n362\t\n363\t\t\ttx, err := d.db.Begin()\n364\t\t\tif err != nil {\n365\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"begin migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n366\t\t\t}\n367\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(ddl); err != nil {\n368\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n369\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"apply migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n370\t\t\t}\n371\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n372\t\t\t\t`INSERT INTO schema_version (version) VALUES (?)`, version,\n373\t\t\t); err != nil {\n374\t\t\t\ttx.Rollback()\n375\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"record migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n376\t\t\t}\n377\t\t\tif err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {\n378\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"commit migration %d: %w\", version, err)\n379\t\t\t}\n380\t\t}\n381\t\treturn nil\n382\t}\n383\t\n384\t// ── groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n385\t\n386\t// GetGroup returns the group with the AND thread_id = ?`, chatID, threadID)\n\treturn scanSession(row)\n}\n\n// CreateSession inserts a new session record.\nfunc (d *DB) CreateSession(ctx context.Context, s *Session) error {\n\tnow := time.Now().UTC()\n\tif s.CreatedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\ts.CreatedAt = now\n\t}\n\tif s.LastActive.IsZero() {\n\t\ts.LastActive = now\n\t}\n\tif s.Status == \"\" {\n\t\ts.Status = \"active\"\n\t}\n\tif s.IconColor == 0 {\n\t\ts.IconColor = 7322096 // Default to light blue (0x6FB9F0)\n\t}\n\tif s.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\ts.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO sessions\n\t\t   (chat_id, thread_id, session_id, cwd, model, status, icon_color, created_at, last_active, message_count, pinned_message_id, total_cost_usd, summary, notification_mode, timeout_sec)\n\t\t VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n\t\ts.ChatID, s.ThreadID, s.SessionID, s.CWD, nullableString(s.Model), s.Status,\n\t\ts.IconColor,\n\t\ts.CreatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.LastActive.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.MessageCount,\n\t\ts.PinnedMessageID,\n\t\ts.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnullableString(s.Summary),\n\t\ts.NotificationMode,\n\t\ts.TimeoutSec,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// UpdateSession updates mutable fields on an existing session.\nfunc (d *DB) UpdateSession(ctx context.Context, s *Session) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`UPDATE sessions\n\t\t SET session_id    = ?,\n\t\t     cwd           = ?,\n\t\t     model         = ?,\n\t\t     status        = ?,\n\t\t     icon_color    = ?,\n\t\t     last_active   = ?,\n\t\t     message_count = ?,\n\t\t     pinned_message_id = ?,\n\t\t     total_cost_usd    = ?,\n\t\t     summary           = ?,\n\t\t     notification_mode = ?,\n\t\t     timeout_sec       = ?,\n\t\t     dispatcher_mode   = ?\n\t\t WHERE chat_id = ? AND thread_id = ?`,\n\t\ts.SessionID, s.CWD, nullableString(s.Model), s.Status,\n\t\ts.IconColor,\n\t\ts.LastActive.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t\ts.MessageCount,\n\t\ts.PinnedMessageID,\n\t\ts.TotalCostUSD,\n\t\tnullableString(s.Summary),\n\t\ts.NotificationMode,\n\t\ts.TimeoutSec,\n\t\ts.DispatcherMode,\n\t\ts.ChatID, s.ThreadID,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// SetSessionIconColor updates only the icon_color field for a session.\nfunc (d *DB) SetSessionIconColor(ctx context.Context, chatID, threadID int64, color int) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`UPDATE sessions SET icon_color = ? WHERE chat_id = ? AND thread_id = ?`,\n\t\tnullableString(summary), chatID, threadID,\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\ntype sessionScanner interface {\n\tScan(dest ...any) error\n}\n\nfunc scanSession(s sessionScanner) (*Session, error) {\n\tvar sess Session\n\tvar createdAt, lastActive string\n\terr := s.Scan(\n\t\t&sess.ChatID, &sess.ThreadID, &sess.SessionID, &sess.CWD,\n\t\t&sess.Model, &sess.Status, &createdAt, &lastActive, &sess.MessageCount, &sess.IconColor,\n\t\t&sess.PinnedMessageID, &sess.TotalCostUSD, &sess.Summary, &sess.NotificationMode, &sess.TimeoutSec,\n\t\t&sess.DispatcherMode,\n\t)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tsess.CreatedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, createdAt)\n\tsess.LastActive, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, lastActive)\n\tif sess.NotificationMode == \"\" {\n\t\tsess.NotificationMode = \"live\"\n\t}\n\treturn &sess, nil\n}\n\n// ── allowed_users ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n// IsUserAllowed returns true if userID is in the allowed_users table.\nfunc (d *DB) IsUserAllowed(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (bool, error) {\n\tvar count int\n\terr := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID,\n\t).Scan(&count)\n\treturn count > 0, err\n}\n\n// GetUserRole returns the role for a user (\"admin\" or \"user\").\n// Returns empty string if user not found.\nfunc (d *DB) GetUserRole(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (string, error) {\n\tvar role string\n\terr := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT role FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID,\n\t).Scan(&role)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn \"\", nil\n\t}\n\treturn role, err\n}\n\n// IsUserAdmin returns true if the user has an \"admin\" role.\nfunc (d *DB) IsUserAdmin(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (bool, error) {\n\trole, err := d.GetUserRole(ctx, userID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn false, err\n\t}\n\treturn role == \"admin\", nil\n}\n\n// GetAllowedUser returns the allowed user record, or (nil, nil) if not found.\nfunc (d *DB) GetAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, userID int64) (*AllowedUser, error) {\n\trow := d.db.QueryRowContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT user_id, role, added_at FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID)\n\n\tvar u AllowedUser\n\tvar addedAt string\n\terr := row.Scan(&u.UserID, &u.Role, &addedAt)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tu.AddedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, addedAt)\n\treturn &u, nil\n}\n\n// UpsertAllowedUser inserts or updates an allowed user.\nfunc (d *DB) UpsertAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, u *AllowedUser) error {\n\tif u.AddedAt.IsZero() {\n\t\tu.AddedAt = time.Now().UTC()\n\t}\n\tif u.Role == \"\" {\n\t\tu.Role = \"user\"\n\t}\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`INSERT INTO allowed_users (user_id, role, added_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\n\t\t ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role`,\n\t\tu.UserID, u.Role, u.AddedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339),\n\t)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// DeleteAllowedUser removes a user from the allow list.\nfunc (d *DB) DeleteAllowedUser(ctx context.Context, userID int64) error {\n\t_, err := d.db.ExecContext(ctx,\n\t\t`DELETE FROM allowed_users WHERE user_id = ?`, userID)\n\treturn err\n}\n\n// ListAllowedUsers returns all allowed users ordered by added_at.\nfunc (d *DB) ListAllowedUsers(ctx context.Context) ([]*AllowedUser, error) {\n\trows, err := d.db.QueryContext(ctx,\n\t\t`SELECT user_id, role, added_at FROM allowed_users ORDER BY added_at`)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer rows.Close()\n\n\tvar users []*AllowedUser\n\tfor rows.Next() {\n\t\tvar u AllowedUser\n\t\tvar addedAt string\n\t\tif err := rows.Scan(&u.UserID, &u.Role, &addedAt); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tu.AddedAt, _ = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, addedAt)\n\t\tusers = append(users, &u)\n\t}\n\treturn users, rows.Err()\n}\n\n// EnsureAdminUser ensures a user exists as an admin in the database.\n// If the user doesn't
